title: SAKSHI company profile
description: One file per profiled health AI deployment, stored as profiles-data/<slug>.json. Profile pages are rendered from these files by build/render-profiles.js and are never hand-edited, so every change to a published finding is a visible commit. Fields follow the four-domain investigative protocol and the governance mechanisms described in the SAKSHI paper. Individual auditors are not named in profiles; profiles are published under the consortium's institutional name and attribution is kept in the certification record.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the file conforms to.

slug.description: URL slug for the profile. Must equal the filename without .json. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

company.description: The company whose claims the profile examines.

name.description: Name as the company uses it publicly.

description.description: One or two neutral sentences on what the company does.

system.description: The specific AI system under review. A company with several products gets one profile per system.

category.description: Kind of system. Free text; common values: diagnostic imaging, triage, autonomous prescribing, clinical decision support, mental health chatbot.

intended_use.description: Intended use as stated by the company.

clinical_autonomy.description: How much of the clinical decision the system makes on its own, as observed in deployment.

version_observed.description: Version or release the findings refer to, if the company publishes one. Profiles are updated as the deployed system changes.

deployment_contexts.description: Where the system is deployed. One entry per country or distinct setting examined.

setting.description: For example: district hospitals, primary care clinics, a state regulatory sandbox.

sites_reported.description: Number or description of sites, as reported by the company or observed by the team.

entry_pathway.description: How the system entered this market: procurement, memorandum of understanding, partnership, sandbox, clearance.

status.description: Status badge shown on the profile. published: findings are public and the company has been notified. response-window-open: the company's window to submit a structured response is open. company-responded: a response was received and is published with the profile. under-reassessment: specific findings are being reassessed following a response or new evidence. corrected: one or more verified corrections have been appended; see correction_log. withdrawn: the profile has been withdrawn by the editorial board, with the reason recorded in correction_log.

hub.description: The regional hub that produced the profile. Individual auditors are not named.

next_review.description: Planned date of the next update. Profiles are continuous, not periodic; this is a floor, not a ceiling.

findings.description: Findings in each of the four investigative domains. The profile gives no single numerical score; each domain is assessed on its own terms.

reporting_guidelines_applied.description: Reporting guidelines the team used to judge the completeness of published evidence.

company_response.description: The appeals and correction mechanism. On publication the company is notified and given a set window to respond. Its response is published with the profile whether it accepts, disputes, or adds evidence.

status.description: no-response means the window closed without a reply. Silence is recorded as a finding.

summary.description: Neutral summary of the response, written by the editorial board.

full_text.description: The response as submitted, published verbatim.

correction_log.description: Append-only record of every change to published findings, with dates. Verified corrections are appended, not written over the original.

fields_changed.description: JSON paths of the fields that changed, for example findings.clinical_evidence_audit.summary.

conflicts_noted.description: Disclosed auditor relationships that fell below the recusal threshold and are therefore noted on the profile.

board_disclosures_url.description: Where the editorial board's composition and conflict of interest disclosures for this profile are published.

summary.description: What the evidence shows, what is missing, and what the gaps mean for this deployment. Plain sentences.

evidence_status.description: Whether evidence exists and whether it supports independent evaluation are kept as separate questions; this field answers the second.

gaps.description: Each item names something the team looked for and did not find, for example a registered trial in the deployment country.

key_questions.description: The protocol's key investigative questions for this domain, with the team's answers.

technical_evaluation.description: The technical evaluation layer that runs alongside the four domains.

reported.description: Whether the company or its published evidence reports this at all.
